title: MECHA — Capteurs & anomalies DBSCAN
description: Séries temporelles des 7 capteurs (7D + cycle_ratio → espace 8D standardisé consommé par DBSCAN). Les points où cluster_label = -1 sont superposés en rouge.

list.name: machine_id
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT machine_id FROM sensor_data ORDER BY machine_id;

panels.title: Score d'anomalie DBSCAN (distance / eps, clampée à 1)

targets.rawSql: SELECT recorded_at AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, anomaly_score AS value FROM predictions WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter(recorded_at) ORDER BY recorded_at;
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, "temperature_C" AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT s."timestamp" AS time, (s.machine_id::text || ' (anomalie)') AS metric, s."temperature_C" AS value FROM sensor_data s JOIN predictions p ON p.machine_id = s.machine_id AND p.recorded_at = s."timestamp" WHERE p.cluster_label = -1 AND s.machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter(s."timestamp") ORDER BY s."timestamp";
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, vibration AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT s."timestamp" AS time, (s.machine_id::text || ' (anomalie)') AS metric, s.vibration AS value FROM sensor_data s JOIN predictions p ON p.machine_id = s.machine_id AND p.recorded_at = s."timestamp" WHERE p.cluster_label = -1 AND s.machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter(s."timestamp") ORDER BY s."timestamp";
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, pressure AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, rpm AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, "consumption_kWh" AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";
SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, voltage AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, machine_id::text AS metric, CASE WHEN target_cycle > 0 THEN cycle_duration::float / target_cycle ELSE 1.0 END AS value FROM sensor_data WHERE machine_id IN ($machine_id) AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY "timestamp";
